components.name: Chart/Generated chart
components.description: Container for a chart that an AI assistant built from the user's data (chat answer, Ask-the-chart). Default: AI mark + timestamp, title, data source, the chart, one AI insight line and actions (Table, Code, Save). Generating: progressive skeleton + spinner + what the model is doing. Always show the source so the user can verify. Chart slot = any Chart/* instance (swap). React: <GeneratedCha
